title: Glazed Tofu and Sweet Soy Noodles
subtitle: with Pak Choy and Sesame Seeds
description: Looking for dinner on the table quick smart? This fast recipe is ready in 25 minutes or less and comes with yumness guaranteed.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Cut the capsicum into thin strips. Coarsely chop the pak choy, keeping the stems and leaves separate. Cut the tofu into 2cm chunks.

Cook noodles: Cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 2 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking. Wipe the pan dry. Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the pan over medium heat. Cook the sesame seeds, stirring, for 2 mins or until golden brown and fragrant (see Kitchen 101).

Soften veggies: Add the capsicum, pak choy stems and 1 tbs water to the sesame seeds and cook, stirring, for 2 mins. Add the kecap manis, 2 tsp soy sauce and 2 tsp white vinegar and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until the veggies are tender but still with crunch. Add the noodles and pak choy leaves and cook, tossing, for 1 min. Remove the pan from the heat.

Glaze tofu: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden and warmed through. Add 2 tsp soy sauce, 2 tsp honey and 1 tbs water and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer, then cook, turning, for 1 min or until the tofu is glazed. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Divide the noodles and veggies among bowls. Top with the tofu and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Our sesame seeds have already been toasted, but doing this again helps release the nutty natural oils and adds even more flavour to the noodles.
